title: Retire the plural `/meta/objects/:name/state/:field` registration: SDK moves to the singular twin, the collision's registration-order pin is deleted (step ② of the #9180 ruling)
body:
Step ② of the #9180 ruling (`/meta` type segment is ALWAYS singular), carved by the spec seat under the maintainer's direct reassignment (2026-08-19, verbatim: 「改派给 spec 席,现在就拆」; audit comment objectstack-ai/objectstack#9180 comment 5349687344).

## The ruling being implemented (⛔ not re-litigable)

Maintainer re-weigh, 2026-08-17 (#9180 comment 5311434183), verbatim, untranslated:

> 「② 照原样做；只需要修正 objectstack objectui cloud 中错误的写法。」

Operative text from the ruling record: **point `meta.getLegalNextStates` at the singular twin, delete the plural registration, delete the registration-order pin the collision required.**

## Measured anchors (2026-08-19, `origin/main` — re-verify at your branch point)

- `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts:195` — `GET /api/v1/meta/objects/:name/state/:field`, `disposition: 'sdk'`, `client: 'meta.getLegalNextStates'` (the plural row)
- `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts:197` — `GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field`, `disposition: 'server-only'` (the singular twin — already mounted)
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:6016-6040` — the mount (`${metaPath}/${objectsSegment}/:name/state/:field`)
- `packages/client/src/index.ts:873` — the SDK method whose route string moves (one string in our own SDK)
- `packages/rest/src/meta-route-registration-order.test.ts` — the order pin that exists only to manage the collision; deleted with it
- `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:352` — the dispatcher-ledger mirror row for the plural spelling; measure whether it moves in the same stroke (ledgers must stay honest to what is mounted)

## Constraints that ride verbatim

- **`model: claude-fable-5` floor, no downward discretion** — standing note on the ruling anchor (#9180 comment 5310450985): every step of this ruling is a contract accept/reject or published-surface change; ⛔ do not dispatch or execute below the floor.
- **⛔ NOT in scope** (re-weigh item 3): the boundary fold (`META_URL_TO_SINGULAR`) stays as a compatibility tolerance for external callers; **no new refusals beyond what step ① (PR #9191) already shipped**. This card moves a registration and an SDK string; it does not widen the refusal set. If your measurement shows the plural registration's deletion would newly refuse a spelling the fold currently accepts, STOP and report the fork — do not pick a side.
- Docs whose prose names the plural state route (release pages are read-only) follow the docs card, not this one.

Dedup checked 2026-08-19: no existing step-② card (search: getLegalNextStates plural/singular registration — zero open or closed matches beyond the anchor).

Part of #9180.
